name: In Reverie of the Past
source:
One can rest in comfort within nostalgic dreams of the past, where the sun warms and never burns. When all is bright and cheery and comforting. But at some point, one has to wake up, return.

Or perhaps this is a place where you can stay forever.

[From [url=https://gray-lofi.itch.io/in-reverie-of-the-past]itch.io[/url]]
